Name: Ford (Custom NPC)
Author: XnixnBvg
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4]This mod is a passion Project I have been stewing up for the past few days, and one of the first mods made on my new pc. This mod features Ford from Story of Seasons: Trio of Towns. If you have my Rung mod installed he will be in Harvey's Room as well. So no need, although his schedule remains the same except after marriage. 

[size=5]Known Issues:

[/size]- His OW Sprite is incomplete, and I'm unsure how to make overworld sprites so I apologize if they look horrible but if you want to fix it, be my guest, I will also credit you if you do so.
- If the player gets the Key of The Town via the section on Ginger Island, then Ford will not be present in Harvey's Room, this is intentional as he's arriving from Westown to Stardew Valley, although he will magically appear all of a sudden. I will fix that in a later date. [/color]
